info.title: Shauth API
info.description: Deployment-neutral identity administration, observability, self-service, and internal caller contracts. Paths are relative to the Shauth service origin, not the GitHub Pages documentation site. Most success responses carry an explicit schema_version and observed_at; health and internal worker/hook responses use the shapes documented per operation. Tokens are distinct runtime-injected bearer credentials. No credentials or deployment URLs are embedded here.

204.description: Client-credentials grant accepted; no account claims.

post.description: For authorization-code and refresh grants, requires an active account and a live correlated sign-in session. Refreshes identity claims from PostgreSQL. Refuses unsupported grants. A sole client_credentials grant returns 204 without account claims.

requestBody.description: The handler reads at most 1 MiB. Additional Hydra fields are accepted.

AdminWrite.description: SHAUTH_ADMIN_API_WRITE_TOKEN: administration mutations; distinct from all read credentials.

CatalogRead.description: SHAUTH_VALIDATION_STATUS_TOKEN: application catalog and validation results only.

Validator.description: SHAUTH_VALIDATOR_TOKEN: real browser validation jobs and bootstrap links only.

TokenHook.description: SHAUTH_TOKEN_HOOK_TOKEN: Ory Hydra token issuance hook only.

BrowserSession.name: __Host-shauth_session
BrowserSession.description: Existing authenticated HTTPS browser session. Loopback-only insecure development uses shauth_session. Self-service is limited to the signed-in account; these operations do not accept administration bearer tokens.

Error.description: Caller-safe error; detailed dependency failures remain in server logs.

SessionPolicy.description: Idle and OIDC SSO lifetimes must not exceed the browser absolute lifetime. Refresh-token lifetime must cover both access and ID-token lifetimes. Durations are integral operator-facing units.

IdentityClaims.description: Current identity claims, retaining additional claims supplied by Hydra, including the correlated sid.

ValidatorJob.description: A claimed real browser-validation job. Witness is null when no second application is available. Runtime coordinates are returned by the service.

password.description: 14–72 UTF-8 bytes; bcrypt rejects longer input.

target.description: Login, organization, or organization/team. User logins are resolved to immutable numeric GitHub IDs.

client_secret.description: At least 32 bytes, supplied only at creation.

CreateOIDCClient.description: Provide a front-channel or back-channel logout URI. All coordinates must share an application origin; HTTPS is required except loopback.

CreateApp.description: Register against an existing confidential OIDC client. URLs use one HTTPS origin (loopback HTTP allowed), with matching registered logout coordinates. release_revision is a 12–64 digit lowercase hexadecimal commit or sha256 digest.

SessionReset.description: Supply user_id or email; user_id takes precedence when both are supplied.

slug.description: Omitted or null queues all apps. A present string must name an app; an empty string is rejected.

items.description: Strictly local relative destination beginning with one slash.

ValidatorResult.description: Completion of an active claimed run. Failure text describes an unsuccessful validation.

TokenHookRequest.description: For account grants, provide a Shauth account UUID in id_token_claims.sub (or id_token.subject), plus ext.sid for a live correlated Hydra session. A sole client_credentials grant needs no account session.

503.description: The endpoint credential is not configured.
